title: The owner's fourth round on the day-42 build: the dead read grey at once, the rammed body drawn in under the hull (a prototype), SOL's road cut 6.5 to 10 cells ahead with rocks taken in road order, THE ARENA straight on the mother, and the purple and brown skins full on the planet as in the lab with a back-face depth twin
context: Owner, 2026-10-19, on Day-42@5c36b5a1, five notes kept verbatim in the session's ledger (.superpowers/sdd/owner-notes-2026-10-19-round-4.md): 1) 'color of dead enemies must immediately fade to grey so we don't mistake them for alive ones'; 2) 'we could investigate better ramming death mechanics, like they are being absorbed under the hull when they die'; 3) 'sector 9, SOL should be opening the road by destroying rocks much ahead of the mork, at least 3 further than it is now, now by the time SOL clears a piece of rock the tank is already past it'; 4) 'sector 9, let's skip the "boss phase 1" of smaller reed, we arrive and it is straight to the boss nih-dairia and the swap of tank / gunship'; 5) 'color of purple enemy is still wrong, they look almost entirely white, they should look like they do in our specimen lab, purple skin'. Three streams in worktrees (notes 1+2, 3+4, 5), each probed with screenshots or a per-cut table before the fix, each reviewed with fix rounds (r4-b two, r4-a one, r4-c two).
outcome: Note 1: the dark death tone of 2026-10-13 was reaching the bodies, but a corpse kept everything that reads alive (the wet glints, rim and back light, the veins' pulse at full strength since a dead body is held at its hop's start, the pearl's white clear-coat glint); at night it looked like a glossy dark live one. PEARL_IMPACT.death { grey 0.12, matte 1, alpha 0.5, seconds 0.08 }: every dead Pearl body, skin and core, one matte neutral grey within 0.08 s, no glints, no pulse (src/fx/cutis-maku/shaders.js, hard-core.js: the emissive goes with the gloss, so a dead pearl is cold under the FLIR; the alpha floor keeps a deflating corpse at >= 0.5 until the fade); the Reeds grey too (CREATURE_REED.grey, src/fx/creature-reed.js); the mother and the shelved Cutis are not greyed. Measured 0.8 s after a kill: dead 65-88 mean brightness and no saturation vs live white 108-138, day and night alike. Note 2: PEARL_IMPACT.absorb { on true, seconds 0.6, back 0.8, reach 4.4 }: a rammed soft body is pulled onto the hull's centre line and back under it, flattened and sunk over the absorb, faded and freed within ~0.9 s (was ~7.5 s: thrown knockRadii ahead, deflating where it landed); a move longer than reach + r falls back to the stagger; an absorbing body neither slows nor pushes the hull (hullContact skips it; a live soft and a cored body beside it are still touched: test/pearl-impact.mjs); the hull pushed dying bodies 51 times before, 0 after. Honest read: at the game's ram camera the body just vanishes near the nose; a prototype for the owner's eye. Note 3: the probe (--arena-drive's per-cut table, state().boss.road.cuts: the hull's chord to each rock at the ask and at the burn's end) found the beam fast (a rock burns in ~0.5 s) but aimed too close: asked 3.2-4.6 cells ahead of a hull at ~2.8 cells/s, a rock was gone 1.8-4.1 cells before the hull reached it, and 4 of 19 never burned (asked just outside the beam's 3.1-cell guard, the hull closed inside it within a frame and the beam held off its whole 2.5 s). ARENA.road clear 3.2 -> 6.5, aheadMetres 50 -> 100, ahead 12 -> 15 (a rock in reach can sit 14 road steps ahead on bends), leadMin 4; the rocks are taken IN ROAD ORDER (the first planned rock down the road outside the guard and within reach, the first cut included; the review's two rounds: a near rock between the guard and `clear` was never asked for again, then a band rock asked before a nearer one starved it); the hand-off keeps the beam on the held rock until the hull is inside the guard of it or it is gone; ARENA_ROAD_GUARD exported once. Measured after: 19 burns, all in the band, none standing, the least lead at a burn's end 5.09 cells (was 1.8). Note 4: ARENA_SECTOR bodies [1], waves 1, boss.waves []: the hull arrives, the hole opens, the mother rises, THE MOTHER card 6.8 s after the hole opens (its own opening effect), the swap; bossWaves([]) is the mother alone (test); 'Small ones first' only in a row with waves; the strip shows her row whole; the brood machinery stays (idle); breath and pulse on the row do nothing with one pulse. Note 5: the purple skin covered ~29 % of what lay behind it and its shader takes no scene light: over the lab's near-black stage it shows its own purple, over the lit floor, the pale pad and the white and blue crowds it reads white. PEARL_MEMBRANE purple and brown: the skin's gain 1.35 (front .86, rim 1, back .46, stalks .25), the pearl drawn over the skin at 0.55; and since a near-opaque skin drawn without depth shows bodies in the wrong order, a depth-only twin writes each full skin's BACK faces (after the soft skins, before every cored skin; stalks and fading bodies write none; a child of the pool's group) and the full-skin pearls draw after the cored skins, depth-tested: a body's own pearl shows through its front skin, anything behind a full-skinned body is hidden; the lab keeps its 0.45 skin with the pearl under it (BESTIARY_STAGE.skin, stageSet()). Measured share of a purple body's pixels that read saturated purple: sector 5 crowd by day 31 % -> 79 %, at night 58 % -> 88 %, the nest 65 % -> 94 %; the twin costs nothing measurable (107 bodies: 18.1 vs 18.8 GPU ms). Brown took the same fix (same numbers, same cause). Still: a purple paints over a soft body in front of it (round three's rule at 0.86), a pearl can be sliced where two bodies overlap close up, the story purple is lighter than the lab's (#6e4a90 vs #5b3d7e). Found on the way: --day-42 red on the base too (1 run in 1; 1 in 3 on the merged tree): the wave armed at the party's end put the gate's warnings and SOL-82's pass on Isao's panel for longer than DAY_42.sayWait and "Party's over. They heard the bass." was dropped; the over line is the alarm's own word, so it now cuts the panel at the alarm (td-tab cutBrief, src/fx/disco-party.js sayOver); the other party lines still wait. The merged tree's --arena-drive then went red once: the hull, quicker with no crowd drag, drifted a cell off the planned road and the road re-laid from its own cell ran through a rock 3 cells ahead; roadKept (src/domain/arena.js) keeps the road while the hull is on it or a cell off, a burn the beam can no longer make is released at once, a rock not yet held is asked for from the guard + 0.25 cells.
alternatives: A darker death tone: the live white tier is itself grey-white, and the corpse kept its glints and pulse; darkness could never separate them.
The ram's absorption off by default: the owner asked to investigate it; the knob is on with the fallback to the stagger, his call in play.
Only pushing the road band out (clear 6.5): the review showed rocks between the guard and the band were never asked for again, then that a band rock starved a nearer one; road order is the rule.
Keeping one small wave before the mother: the owner's note is 'straight to the boss'; the machinery stays for a row that has waves.
A thinner purple tint or a darker core: over a bright floor a 29 % skin reads as the floor; coverage was the lever, and depth had to follow it.
evidence: test/pearl-impact.mjs (the grey, the absorb's reach, the hull-contact exemption), test/creature-reed.mjs (the Reed grey on the real kit), test/boss-run.mjs (road order, the two-rock drive at 2.8 cells/s, the hand-off, the seat case, the cut log copied), test/boss-sector.mjs (bossWaves([])), test/pearl-enemies.mjs (the gain, the pearls, the twins, the lab's copy); npm test 279 programs; npm run architecture (td-tab 6,191 of 6,400, one line changed)

browser on the final tree 530a5d3c: --arena-drive (21 burns, 20 in band, none standing, the least lead at a burn's end 5.29 cells), --arena (the card 6.8 s after the hole, no small hunters, her death secures), --day-42 twice (the over line at the alarm over a gate warning), --story-world, --sectors, --dead-probe (the kill pairs day and night, the ram series); --bestiary and --pearl-story are red on the base and on main since 6841d61a (THE BLOB: the glide path skips the motion audit): stale suites, bisected (.superpowers/sdd/r4-bisect-report.md)

screenshots in the session's ledger folder: r4-a-compare-kill-day.png / r4-a-fix-compare-kill-night.png (grey corpses beside live bodies), r4-a-fix-ram-series.png, r4-c-fix-*.png and r4-c-brown-*.png (the skins, the lined-up pack), r4-c-cost-pile.png

open for the owner: grey 0.12 (0.16 lighter, 0.09 darker); the absorption barely reads at the ram camera (seconds / back are the knobs); the Reeds' grey seen in the lane, not yet the arena; the card pauses the game the moment the mother appears (seen rising first?); the hole opens silent; Isao hands the wheel back ~7 s while the hole forms; a purple over a soft body in front of it; brown changed unasked; a bug filed on the base: the leash's dissolve re-places a cored body under the hull (src/fx/creature-pearl.js place(): clears rock, not the hull; the opacity gate skips contact until it is inside; the push-out spikes the hull ~182 m/s once)
